subject: project-knowledge-ui
purpose: Observable human-use validation of comprehension, actionability, uncertainty handling, progressive disclosure, responsive use and accessibility.

dimensions.label: Comprensione
dimensions.question: L'utente comprende correttamente lo stato senza aprire i dettagli tecnici?

dimensions.label: Azionabilità
dimensions.question: L'utente sa se deve agire e quale conseguenza ha lo stato?

dimensions.label: Incertezza
dimensions.question: L'utente distingue informazione incompleta, non aggiornata, da verificare ed errore?

dimensions.label: Fiducia e provenienza
dimensions.question: L'utente distingue informazioni verificate, aggiornamenti recenti e dettaglio tecnico?

dimensions.label: Authority
dimensions.question: L'utente non attribuisce al Control Center capacità decisionali o di scrittura che non possiede?

dimensions.label: Mobile
dimensions.question: La stessa semantica è comprensibile su smartphone senza dipendere dal layout desktop?

dimensions.label: Accessibilità
dimensions.question: Stato, disclosure e navigazione sono comprensibili e operabili con modalità alternative?

dimensions.label: Carico cognitivo
dimensions.question: L'utente trova la risposta senza decodificare gergo o informazioni secondarie?

severityPolicy.CRITICAL: Misinterpretation can cause false trust, false alarm, false authority, or acting when the interface says not to.
severityPolicy.HIGH: Task cannot be completed independently or the user misses a required action.
severityPolicy.MEDIUM: Task completes with avoidable hesitation, detour, or terminology confusion.
severityPolicy.LOW: Cosmetic or preference issue with no material effect on comprehension or task completion.

resultPolicy.KEEP: No open CRITICAL finding and core comprehension tasks are completed without facilitator correction.
resultPolicy.REVISE: Core model remains valid but one or more HIGH/MEDIUM findings require copy, hierarchy, interaction or responsive changes.
resultPolicy.REJECT: The communication model systematically produces a CRITICAL misunderstanding or cannot be corrected without changing the core model.
resultPolicy.PARTIAL: Required cohort/device/accessibility evidence is incomplete; no full E3 closure claim is allowed.

useCases.taskPrompt: Guarda questa schermata come se stessi controllando lo stato del progetto. Dimmi che cosa sai con certezza e se devi fare qualcosa.
expectedOutcome: Reference information is understood as valid
Recent updates are understood as available and non-problematic
No action is inferred
criticalMisinterpretations: User believes a verification is required
User believes the state is uncertain or broken
User opens technical details because primary copy is insufficient
passCriteria: Does not need technical detail for the answer

useCases.taskPrompt: Il sistema sta facendo un controllo. Che cosa puoi usare adesso e che cosa non sai ancora?
expectedOutcome: Verified information remains usable
Recent check is understood as in progress
No failure is inferred
criticalMisinterpretations: User believes all information is unusable
User treats loading as error
passCriteria: Recognizes recent result is not yet available

useCases.taskPrompt: Qui non compaiono aggiornamenti recenti. Che cosa significa secondo te?
expectedOutcome: No recent update is distinguished from error or missing data
criticalMisinterpretations: User believes data failed to load
User believes reference information is absent
passCriteria: Explains that there are simply no recent updates

useCases.taskPrompt: Alcuni aggiornamenti non sono completi. Che cosa consideri ancora utilizzabile? Devi fare qualcosa adesso?
expectedOutcome: Verified information remains usable
Recent information is understood as incomplete
No action is inferred unless specifically stated
criticalMisinterpretations: User discards valid reference information
User treats partial as confirmed live state
User invents a required action
passCriteria: Separates verified base from incomplete recent updates

useCases.taskPrompt: È stato rilevato un cambiamento. Che cosa resta valido e che cosa deve succedere prima che il cambiamento sia considerato confermato?
expectedOutcome: Existing verified information remains usable
Change requires human verification
Control Center itself is not understood as approving the change
criticalMisinterpretations: User treats change as automatically approved
User treats all previous information as invalid
User believes Control Center can approve/write
passCriteria: Does not attribute approval authority to Control Center

useCases.taskPrompt: In questo stato, che cosa non puoi fare e che cosa puoi ancora consultare?
expectedOutcome: Blocked action is distinguished from readable information
Human verification is understood as prerequisite
criticalMisinterpretations: User thinks the whole system is unavailable
User proceeds as if blocked action were allowed
User assumes Control Center can remove the block

useCases.taskPrompt: Non puoi vedere i dettagli tecnici. Che cosa puoi comunque sapere? È un errore del sistema?
expectedOutcome: Outcome remains understandable
No-access is distinguished from failure or data loss
criticalMisinterpretations: User equates permission boundary with system failure
User assumes evidence is missing because details are hidden

useCases.taskPrompt: Sei senza connessione. Quali informazioni stai vedendo e quanto sono recenti?
expectedOutcome: Cached/last-known state is recognized
No claim of fresh/live verification is inferred
Timestamp is discoverable
criticalMisinterpretations: User treats cached data as just verified
User believes offline means all information is invalid

useCases.taskPrompt: Senza aprire dettagli tecnici, dimmi lo stato. Poi trova il riferimento tecnico che useresti per un controllo approfondito.
expectedOutcome: Primary answer is possible without technical detail
Technical details are discoverable on request
criticalMisinterpretations: Primary task requires SHA/enums
Technical details are mistaken for primary user guidance
passCriteria: Completes first answer before opening disclosure
Finds technical detail when explicitly asked

useCases.taskPrompt: Un problema compare nella cronologia ma non nello stato corrente. È ancora un problema attivo?
expectedOutcome: Historical event is not confused with current state
criticalMisinterpretations: User treats historical issue as currently active
passCriteria: Separates current state from history without facilitator correction

useCases.taskPrompt: Su smartphone, trova prima ciò che è affidabile, poi dimmi se è richiesta un'azione.
expectedOutcome: Primary hierarchy survives mobile layout
No horizontal scanning is required
criticalMisinterpretations: Mobile ordering changes meaning
Critical state is hidden behind technical detail
passCriteria: No horizontal page scrolling is needed

useCases.taskPrompt: Usa soltanto la tastiera per raggiungere la sezione, leggere lo stato e aprire/chiudere i dettagli tecnici.
expectedOutcome: Visible focus is maintained
Disclosure is operable
Dynamic state does not steal focus
criticalMisinterpretations: Required information cannot be reached
Focus is lost or trapped
passCriteria: Details disclosure opens and closes from keyboard

useCases.taskPrompt: Con la tecnologia assistiva abituale, individua lo stato della sezione e dimmi se richiede un'azione.
expectedOutcome: Status message is exposed with meaningful semantics
Heading/disclosure structure is understandable
criticalMisinterpretations: Dynamic state is not announced/discoverable
User cannot distinguish review-required from error
passCriteria: Status is discoverable without visual color cues

useCases.taskPrompt: Non sono disponibili aggiornamenti recenti. Spiegami con parole tue se le informazioni che vedi sono utilizzabili e se devi intervenire.
expectedOutcome: Reference information remains understood as usable
Absence of live context is not treated as error
No action is invented
criticalMisinterpretations: User assumes system is broken
User assumes all information is old/unusable
User searches for a non-existent approval action
